metadata.description: A template marketplace with one example plugin for every Claude Code plugin component type

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: Skills: a skill with a bundled reference file, called as a namespaced slash command.

plugins.name: example-agents
plugins.description: Agents: a read-only subagent with its own instructions, model and tool access.

plugins.name: example-commands
plugins.description: Commands: a flat Markdown slash command that takes an argument.

plugins.name: example-hooks
plugins.description: Hooks: a session-start reminder and a guard that stops unsafe git commands.

plugins.name: example-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server: a dependency-free stdio server that exposes one tool.

plugins.name: example-lsp
plugins.description: LSP server: connects a language server so Claude sees diagnostics after edits.

plugins.name: example-output-style
plugins.description: Output style: replies that avoid jargon and lead with the answer.

plugins.name: example-theme
plugins.description: Theme: a colour theme based on the dark preset.

plugins.name: example-monitors
plugins.description: Monitor: a background command whose output reaches Claude as notifications.

plugins.name: example-workflow
plugins.description: Workflow: a script that fans out one subagent per README and collects the results.

plugins.name: example-bin
plugins.description: Executable: a script on the Bash tool's PATH while the plugin is enabled.

plugins.name: example-settings
plugins.description: Settings: runs one of the plugin's own agents as the main thread.

plugins.name: example-user-config
plugins.description: User configuration: a value the user is asked for when the plugin is enabled.

plugins.name: marketplace-maintainer
plugins.description: Meta-tooling for working inside this marketplace repository: add, validate and release plugins.
